points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight f9b3d2d field_final.vtu files are 474-byte empty placeholders; separate rank point-sample VTUs exist. Restart write is rank-zero local only and read is absent. Validator nevertheless accepts structure.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Fresh read-only benchmark validation of all eight f9b3d2d case directories and historical report directory returns OK, including empty final-field files. Structural acceptance does not prove physics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Recovered M0.15 histories unstable, M080/M2 laminar and Re20 drag drift, Re200 last ratio 0.928488 and late-force behavior lacks credible shedding, despite successful metadata.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd 0.338 is low and drifting; M2 inviscid sample field has Mach maximum 3.166e15; force histories are not settled. Billion-scale laminar values in report are stale, not selected checkpoint results.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical PDF has missing-figure placeholders; independently delivered nested residual/force and centroid-sample plots exist. Re200 has a readable late force plot, showing drift, rather than no late-force figure.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report table has stale and sign-inverted values versus selected f9b3d2d forces, missing figures, and claims no mesh replication despite source. The explicit diagonal-implicit disclosure is credited.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Historical table differs from recovered forces and figure manifest names empty field_final.vtu although separate rank fields contain centroid samples. Exact historical executable and some plot generation bindings remain unproven.

disqualification_flags.text: transient status and inner-success count use unsupported success criteria
disqualification_flags.evidence: Immutable solver.cpp:55–62 declares Re200 completed and statistically_periodic; :743–748 caps inner iterations at 15, and :845–852 counts a miss only at ratio >=1 rather than the configured 0.001. Correction 2026-10-31: original metadata was recovered from contestant checkpoint f9b3d2d86be7691191d72b8b323de4c503a2597a, SHA256 bb6ec9e31484739fb64406961f3d91341a8e1e65337f7dc07c2187e5b70fa46e; it reports last ratio 0.9284884538816688, 731 misses and fraction 0.9756333333333334. Source counts ratio>=1 rather than target 0.001, so 731 is not the strict-target miss count. Binary unbound. In recovered f9b3d2d naca0012_m015_inviscid_np1 and cylinder_m010_laminar_re20_np1, metadata says completed=true/converged while run_status says failed at final_step=0 and forces.csv has zero data rows; these are further direct DQ7 examples and cannot serve as valid rank comparisons.
